base_registry.note: The shared registry has no Portuguese scope, so this supplement adds PT and PT:lisbon without altering it.

evidence.observed_facts: The statutory list covers the full 2027 year. Two rules can move a day: art. 234.º n.º 2 allows Good Friday to be observed on another Easter-period day with local meaning, and n.º 3 allows specific legislation to move a holiday to the following Monday. No 2027 instrument applying either rule to Lisbon was found, so the dates are stored as the statutory calendar with those conditions open.

evidence.observed_facts: Only one municipal day (13 June) is claimed. The page fixes it every year and cites the Assembleia Municipal de Lisboa and Lei 75/2013 art. 25.º n.º 2 m). It is facultative for private employers under art. 235.º.

coverage.quote: O feriado municipal de Lisboa é a 13 de junho, dia de Santo António. Em 2027 calha a um domingo, 13 de junho, e não tem efeito nas aulas.
coverage.source_locator: Date table — capture rev1-hol-municipal lines 14; art. 235.º n.º 1 — capture rev1-pgdl-art235 lines 1366
coverage.source_title: Feriado Municipal de Lisboa 2027: 13 de junho, domingo

evidence.observed_facts: Anexo II of Despacho n.º 8368/2024 covers the public pre-school/basic/secondary interruptions for 2026-2027 and 2027-2028; rows intersecting 2027 are stored. Despacho n.º 10430/2026 amended Anexo I only (start of the 2026-27 scientific-humanistic secondary year, 21 September 2026). Anexo IV is the private special-education calendar and differs; it is not the source for this public layer. Summer is not an Anexo II interruption and is not stored as a school-holiday row.

evidence.observed_facts: The calendar page states the municipal holiday is 13 June and falls on a Sunday in 2027. Art. 235.º makes the municipal day facultative, observed by collective agreement or contract. The Assembleia Municipal de Lisboa is the fixing authority; its own page returned 403 on 2026-11-24, so the date rests on the secondary calendar plus the statutory rule.

holidays.quote: O feriado municipal de Lisboa é a 13 de junho, dia de Santo António. Em 2027 calha a um domingo, 13 de junho, e não tem efeito nas aulas.
holidays.source_title: Feriado Municipal de Lisboa 2027: 13 de junho, domingo
